description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 2 with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Wind/Water/Fire/Earth damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Onion Knight (Wind, Water, Fire, Earth)] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Onion Knight (Wind, Water, Fire, Earth)
description.text: Increases [Fire/Earth/Wind/Water Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire, Earth, Wind, and Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Onion Knight (Fire, Earth, Wind, Water) after using a Fire, Earth, Wind or Water ability (max 3), grants [Critical 100% 3] to the user after triggering three times, maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Multi-Hit+
description.text: Five single attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Onion Knight (Fire, Earth, Wind, Water)
Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Water 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Earth 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
